row.title: Slice SW+FX of the specification run shipped together
row.body: The seed's spec tests (SW) need the fixer code (FX) to pass, so the two ship as one change. A credential store with no database binding now rejects at once with a plain reason. The US-09 reply-gate test accepts the router naming the reply keys.

title: Slice SW+FX of the specification run shipped together
